comparison.objective: Pass a wafer carrier through an interlocked airlock without opening both gates together; the candidate adjusts a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Carrier transfer plus safe gate sequencing, not threaded countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier crosses while the two gates are never simultaneously open; the indexed body lacks a fuller numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: A missing threshold does not obscure the clearly different interlock-and-transfer ability.
